q: The KAM theorem (Kolmogorov–Arnold–Moser) says that for a slightly perturbed integrable Hamiltonian:
opts: Most tori with sufficiently irrational frequency ratios survive the perturbation
exp: KAM: for small perturbations of an integrable Hamiltonian, a positive measure set of invariant tori (those with 'sufficiently irrational' frequency vectors, satisfying a Diophantine condition) persist. The complement (Arnold diffusion) may be complicated.
